notes.title: "G-MODE Archives" 2nd Anniversary Sale from 4/28!
notes.content:
G-MODE Archives" 2nd Anniversary Sale will be held on Steam® from 4/28.

Based on the "G-MODE Archives" and "G-MODE Archives+" surveys conducted to commemorate the 2nd anniversary of G-MODE Archives, various titles will be offered at 10-50% off!

RPGs, shooters, adventures, puzzles, simulations, and more at .......
Please take advantage of the sale and enjoy the many classic titles that were once available on feature phones at a discounted price!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
【Sale period】2022/4/28 0:00 - 5/12 0:00 (Japan time)
【Store page】https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/G-MODE

Pickup titles for sale
G-MODE Archives 01 Flyhight Cloudia *50% OFF
G-MODE Archives 28 Sepas Channel *50% OFF
G-MODE Archives 17 Flyhight Cloudia 3 *25%OFF
G-MODE Archives 09 Flyhight Cloudia 2 *25%OFF
G-MODE Archives 39 Flyhight Cloudia 4 *25%OFF
G-MODE Archives+ Dodonpachi Daioujou DX *25%OFF
Other G-MODE Archives and G-MODE Archives+ titles *10% OFF

*Sale periods are subject to change without notice.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What is G-MODE Archives?
G-MODE Archives is a reissue project to deliver faithful reproductions of former feature phone game apps as they were in the past, under the theme of "saving all the apps that are getting lost".

List of "G-MODE Archives" titles
https://gmodecorp.com/gmodearchives/
